title: Position Words
short: Use words like above, below, beside, in front of and behind.

blocks.html: Position words tell where something is. Where is the teddy bear?

blocks.name: k-pic
blocks.cap: The bear is behind the box. The box hides part of the bear.

blocks.html: Position words tell where a thing is compared with something else.
“Where?” only makes sense next to another thing. The bear is not just “under”; it is under the table.

blocks.title: Turn it around
blocks.q: The ball is under the chair. Where is the chair?
steps: If the ball is under the chair,
then the chair is above the ball.

blocks.html: For grown-ups: Play “I spy” with position words: “I spy something behind the sofa.” Let your child give clues too.

sources.name: Common Core State Standards for Mathematics, Kindergarten, K.G.A.1: describe the relative positions of objects using words such as above, below, beside, in front of, behind and next to
Institute of Education Sciences practice guide: Teaching Math to Young Children (NCEE 2014-4005)
